transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Ben. What can I help you with today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Ben. I'm moving house at the end of the month and I want to take my broadband with me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, congratulations on the move. So you'd like to move your S-Net broadband to your new home at the end of the month. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I take your PIN to get into the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Ingrid. What's the new postcode, so I can check what's available there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what's your moving date exactly?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Will anyone be in at the new place before then, or is that the first day you'll have keys?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I get the keys on the twenty-eighth.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. Good news, the new address can get the same five hundred meg fibre. I can book the switch for the twenty-ninth, and an engineer visit isn't needed because the property already has a fibre point. Shall I go ahead?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Done. Your current address will switch off on the twenty-ninth at midnight, and the new one goes live the same morning. Just take your router with you and plug it into the fibre point.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything about the move that's still unclear, or have I covered everything you needed?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant. Good luck with the move, Ingrid. Thank you for choosing S-Net.
